articles.mainIdea: SPECTRUM OPENS APPLICATIONS FOR SIXTH CLASS OF SPECTRUM SCHOLARS
articles.summary: PR Newswire: SPECTRUM OPENS APPLICATIONS FOR SIXTH CLASS OF SPECTRUM SCHOLARS. Spectrum today opened applications for its sixth class of Spectrum Scholars, the Company's annual scholarship and career-development program for students with financial need. The award-winning Spectrum Scholars program pairs a $20,000 scholarship with a two-year professional development program and paid internship with Spectrum.
